“老二，你往边上挪挪。”
“俺要带你出世了！”
“……”
陆生被声音吵醒，睁开双眼。
周围依旧是无尽的黑暗，
“唉……”
陆生叹了口气，终于认命。
他确认了，自己并不是在做梦。
他是真的穿越了！
而且，还是穿越到了西游世界。
陆生往身后望去。
身后的黑暗中。
有一个身影，正急地抓耳挠腮。

这时。
一道毫无情感的声音响起：
“叮！”
“恭喜宿主成功穿越至“西游世界”
，重生为天地奇石。”
“为宿主正式开启【西游任务系统】！”
是的！
他穿越到了西游世界，成为了大圣“一石同胞”
的弟弟。
石头内。
见陆生迟迟没有动静。
孙悟空叹了口气：
“唉，老二，是俺对不住你！”
“俺一直都以为，这石头里只有俺一个。”
“导致所有的日月精华，都让俺给吸收完了！”
“等俺带你出世了，一定想办法补偿你。”

"Second brother, move to the side."
"I'm going to take you out of the world!"
"..."
Lu Sheng was awakened by the sound and opened his eyes.
There is still endless darkness all around,
"Alas..."
Lu Sheng sighed, finally accepting his fate.
He confirmed that he was not dreaming.
He really traveled through time!
Moreover, he still traveled to the world of Journey to the West.
Lu Sheng looked behind him.
In the darkness behind.
There was a figure scratching his head and ears anxiously.
At this time.
An emotionless voice sounded:
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host for successfully traveling to "Journey to the West"
, reborn as a strange stone in heaven and earth. "
"Officially open the [Journey to the West Mission System] for the host!"
Yes!
He traveled to the world of Journey to the West and became the Great Sage's "one-stone compatriot"
's younger brother.
Within the stone.
Seeing that Lu Sheng had not made any movement.
Sun Wukong sighed:
"Oh, second brother, I can't help you!"
"I always thought that I was the only one in this stone."
"As a result, I have absorbed all the essence of the sun and moon!"
"When I bring you into the world, I will definitely find a way to compensate you."
